hook_en: When you're in deep water, He answers. 🙏
reflect_en: With the floods rising around him, David didn't pretend to be fine; he asked the LORD to answer him because His loving devotion is good. This Sunday, whatever feels like it's pulling you under, you can pray just as honestly and trust His great compassion to turn toward you.
q_en: What feels like deep water in your life right now?
x_en: Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good; turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.
tiktok: When the waters rise, pray this 🙏 Psalm 69:15–17 — Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good
yt_title: Answer Me, O LORD, for Your Loving Devotion Is Good | Psalm 69:15–17 #Shorts
yt_line: Bring Him your honest prayer today.
li_open: Some weeks, leaders feel in over their heads.
li_quote: Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good; turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.
li_body: David prayed with brutal honesty when he felt the floods closing in, and he anchored that prayer in God's goodness and compassion. Leaders who pray honestly about their own distress, and create space for their people to do the same, build communities where no one has to pretend they are fine.
hook_es: Cuando las aguas suben, Él te oye. 🙏
reflect_es: Con el ímpetu de las aguas a su alrededor, David no fingió estar bien: le pidió a Jehová que lo oyera, porque apacible es Su misericordia. Este domingo, sea lo que sea que sientes que te hunde, puedes orar con la misma honestidad y confiar en que Él te mira conforme a la multitud de Sus misericordias.
q_es: ¿Qué situación sientes que te está hundiendo en este momento?
x_es: Oyeme, Jehová, porque apacible es tu misericordia; mírame conforme a la multitud de tus miseraciones.
